# PyneTS
> TypeScript / Bun library for Pine Script — parse, unparse, interpret, JS-compile

PyneTS is the library-shaped port of PYNE: the same ANTLR grammar, the same ASDL AST, the same interpret contract. Python pynescript is the source of truth. Package: @hoox-sh/pyne-ts.

## Primary

- [Docs](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs): Full documentation hub
- [Repository](https://github.com/hoox-sh/pyne-ts): Source
- [Docs tree](https://github.com/hoox-sh/pyne-ts/tree/main/docs): MDX source of truth
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hoox-sh/pyne-ts): Published package (0.11.1)
- [llm.txt](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs/llm.txt): Plain-text index of every page
- [llms.txt](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs/llms.txt): This file
- [PYNE docs](https://hoox.sh/pyne/docs): Language runtime (separate product)
- [HOOX docs](https://hoox.sh/docs): Edge trade mesh

## Docs

- [Overview](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs): What PyneTS is / is not, numbers, interface surface
- [Install](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs/install): Bun / npm / esm.sh; Node vs Bun entries; CLI needs Bun
- [CLI](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs/cli): check / format / run / dump / info; pipes stay JSON; exit codes
- [Runtime](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs/runtime): run() contract, na semantics, streaming, realtime windows, providers
- [Compile](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs/compile): JS bar-loop emit (mode compile|auto); not Numba; shared TA tables
- [Parity](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs/parity): Python oracle workflow; snapshot PYNE 0.6.32 · 941/941 builtins
- [Missing features](https://hoox.sh/pyne-ts/docs/missing-features): What still differs from Python; what closed in waves 11–14
